Exhaustive case analysis of the first source shows exactly the empty, singleton and two-star-pair green sets and their complements. An explicit conjugation of signed influence sums proves the switched code-distance identity. Actual independent state enumeration verifies twenty graph families and 20,544 switching-word distances and checks 192 switched signatures; finite checks are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This supplies a complete terminal-code characterization and all-signing plurality law on an infinite natural unbalanced graph family for the 2026 signed-burning model. It distinguishes a geometric covering-radius jump between equal and unequal bipartition sizes at the same total vertex count although the complete Hamming weight enumerator is identical. The degree-at-least-three hypothesis is the sharp strict-majority regime, avoiding arbitrary instance selection. The exact classification and explicit deepest-hole uniqueness in the balanced-part case are plausible reusable examples for signed-burning code geometry.
